what_this_is: First independent accuracy measurement of the OILTRACE segmentation model, on the author's own held-out test split.
model: ResNet50 DeepLabV3+ (Satyanarayana & Dhali, ICPRAM 2025), MIT licensed

test_set.source: Krestenitis/MKLab M4D oil spill dataset, standard 1002/110 split
test_set.provenance_note: Obtained via a public Kaggle mirror; formal request to the authors (MKLab/CERTH) is pending via supervisor.
test_set.leakage_check: Author trained on the 1002-image train split (951/51 train/val). These 110 test images were held out. No leakage.

preprocessing: Author's exact path: img_0814.jpg anchor padding (650x1250 -> 672x1280), ToTensor, Normalize(mean=0.5185, std=0.197).

land_correction.issue: 3 of 110 mirror masks carry 5/23/39 stray land pixels from compression artefacts, not real annotation.

imbalance_baselines.note: This is why pixel accuracy is the wrong metric. A detector that finds nothing scores 98.9%.

global_vs_per_image.note: Per-image mean is the author's method and the published convention. Global (pooled confusion matrix) is stricter.

verdict: Independent reproduction of the published result. 3 of 5 classes match to <=0.005 points; land matches to 0.001 once mirror mask artefacts are excluded; ship is 0.95 points low, likely the same artefact effect on very small regions.
